entry.title: Trump says Fort Hood shooter can be executed by firing squad
entry.summary: The last time the U.S. military held an execution was in 1961, by hanging. The last military execution by firing squad was in 1945, when an American soldier was shot for desertion in World War II.

entry.title: Cornell names former acting U.S. attorney general to review rape case
entry.summary: Cornell University names Sally Yates, former acting U.S. attorney general and career federal prosecutor, to lead an independent review into how the school handled a former student's rape allegations.

entry.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
entry.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

entry.title: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
entry.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

entry.title: Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey's new Pentagon roles raise ethics worries
entry.summary: Musk's company, SpaceX, and Luckey's company Anduril, could potentially benefit from recommendations made in the study about future autonomous weapon systems.

entry.title: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
entry.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

entry.title: As Trump focuses the FBI on immigration, counterintelligence is falling behind
entry.summary: The cuts come as a consequence of President Trump and FBI Director Kash Patel's focus on violent crime and immigration, leaving other priorities understaffed.

entry.title: Dennis Hastert, longtime Republican House speaker who went to prison, dies at age 84
entry.summary: ennis Hastert, whose political legacy as Congress' longest-serving Republican House speaker was later fouled by allegations that he had molested high school athletes during his prior career as a teacher and wrestling coach, has died, a coroner said Monday. He was 84.

entry.title: FBI arrests a woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader's family for China
entry.summary: The FBI and U.S. prosecutors say Wanying Zhang, also know as Heather, surveilled the Taiwanese president's son and his family.

entry.title: Super El Niño is here. What's so super about it?
entry.summary: This year, federal forecasters say the planet could see the strongest El Niño event on record. Here's what you need to know.
